title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00009:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Sender and Recipient)
① For postal money transfers, the sender and recipient must be individual persons. However, for online money transfers that include a condolence message as specified in Article 32, the sender can be up to 10 people. <Amended July 31, 1998>
② If the sender consists of 2 or more people, as specified in the first paragraph of this article, the sender must pay the amount determined and announced by the Minister of Science, Information and Communication. <Amended July 31, 1998, March 3, 2008, March 24, 2013, July 26, 2017>
